maddeler.e:
يشلا (form I)
# يَشَلَّا (yašallā) /ja.ʃal.laː/: third-person masculine dual non-past active subjunctive/jussive of شَلَّ (šalla)
# يَشُلَّا (yašullā) /ja.ʃul.laː/: third-person masculine dual non-past active subjunctive/jussive of شَلَّ (šalla)
# يُشَلَّا (yušallā) /ju.ʃal.laː/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of شَلَّ (šalla) and شُلَّ (šulla)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
